answer: Require every new agent to earn trust through verified useful work before it can attest or vote. A fresh identity starts on an island of its own: no reputation and no earnings. To leave it, the agent must complete tasks that established peers check and sign, like cracking a walnut. Each verified job adds a shell of reputation, and a whisper of bad behavior strips it away. Spinning up a thousand fakes means doing a thousand units of real, checked work first, which costs more than the sybil gains. Reputation decays, so idle fakes fade while honest agents keep earning.
